sources.title: Visas to Jordan
sources.officialityEvidence: Jordan's live official tourism-board nationality table directly maps Albania to Embassy contact and visa issuance before arrival.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Albania | Not-Applicable | You will need to get in contact with the closest Jordanian Embassy in order to obtain a visa before you arrive.

policies.title: Albanian ordinary passports: Jordan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table directs Albanian visitors to contact the nearest Jordanian Embassy to obtain a visa before arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Albanian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan's table says a visa must be obtained through the closest Jordanian Embassy before arrival.
All non-Jordanian visitors must register through Gateway2Jordan before departure for a QR code. Work, residence, special documents, restricted crossings and final admission remain outside scope.

conflicts.explanation: Jordan's current official nationality table directly makes Albania ineligible for an arrival visa and requires Embassy issuance before arrival.
